_about: Public-domain Emil Schürer (1844-1910, Giessen) in English for the Word Hoard: A History of the Jewish People in the Time of Jesus Christ, the Clark set in five volumes (1885-1890), tr. John Macpherson (Division I) and Sophia Taylor and Peter Christie (Division II), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 30 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
